meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The Vulture's Tithe
quests.narrative_guidance: Vrax demands a show of force against a group of unruly scavengers hiding in the slums.
improvisation_points: Consult Brawn-Master Grog about the scavenger locations.
Secure the support of Shanty-King Jax to bypass local lookouts.
Deliver the confiscated loot to Flame-Gazer Zora for smelting.

quests.title: The Relic Crucible
quests.narrative_guidance: High Smelter Iral has prophesied a holy vessel buried in the rust flats.
improvisation_points: Receive the prophecy coordinates from Stir-Witch Helga.
Hire Silt-Sifter Mara to excavate the artifact from the flats.
Bring the relic to Anvil-Lord Boros for purification.

quests.title: The Forbidden Alloy
quests.narrative_guidance: Tessa Korr seeks a rare reactor alloy but needs to hide the transaction from the Technocracy.
improvisation_points: Acquire the scrap list from Scrap-Lord Otto.
Forge the quality certificates with Quality-Control Kael.
Launder the payment through Drip-Counter Fin's accounts.

quests.title: The Fragment's Deletion
quests.narrative_guidance: Dravven suspects an AI remnant is hiding in the ratchet mechanisms of the Spire.
improvisation_points: Get the security clearance from Iron-Wall Iris.
Identify the corrupted gears with Click-Clack Cleo.
Install the stabilizer at Gravity-Anchor Alpha to purge the system.

quests.title: The Impossible Load
quests.narrative_guidance: Jurik Vale has found an ore chunk too heavy for any normal crane.
improvisation_points: Locate the ore with Pick-Eye Pete.
Calculate the stress tolerances with Stress-Tester Stan.
Rig the tension cables with Tight-Wire Ty to haul it up.

quests.title: The Sabotage Strike
quests.narrative_guidance: Miran Flux wants to trigger a controlled explosion to disrupt the Smelters' influence.
improvisation_points: Deliver the explosive components to Rat-Run Rene.
Rig the vapor valves with Pressure-Valen.
Use the Spire-Tip Observatory with Sky-Watcher Sol to time the blast.

quests.title: Foundry Blueprints
quests.narrative_guidance: The AI Fragment reveals coordinates to ancient technical drawings hidden in the Spire depths.
improvisation_points: Descend into the Counterweight Pit with Deep-Drop Dale.
Bypass the filtration security with Silk-Spinner Sam.
Signal the extraction from Scavenger's Perch with Talon-Talon.

quests.title: The Scavenger's Gambit
quests.narrative_guidance: A high-stakes run through the wires to deliver a critical component to the Scav-Lord.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the Wire-Walk pulse-relay from Slink.
Take the relay to Spike for precision modification.
Deliver the modified relay to Vrax Cinderskull in the Reach.

quests.title: Visions of the Crucible
quests.narrative_guidance: Gathering the necessary vapors and mechanical precision to satisfy Iral's prophecy.
improvisation_points: Collect pure solder-vapor from Mist-Walker Zephyr.
Have Pin-Prick calibrate a containment vessel.
Present the vessel to High Smelter Iral at the altar.

quests.title: The Slag Extraction
quests.narrative_guidance: A heavy lifting operation to retrieve forbidden tech from the deep slabs.
improvisation_points: Secure the slab-coordinates from Skid.
Climb the main shaft with Oryn to bypass the blockade.
Deliver the tech to Jurik Vale for analysis.

quests.title: Drone Network Hijack
quests.narrative_guidance: Repurposing Technocracy drones to serve the guild's local interests.
improvisation_points: Intercept a command drone with Dravven's 'assistance'.
Purchase a bypass-cog from Cog-Dealer Rim.
Sync the drone at Piston-Swing Plaza with Rhythm's help.

quests.title: Shard-Glass Smuggling
quests.narrative_guidance: Moving rare alloyed glass across the city heights without being spotted.
improvisation_points: Pick up the alloy crates from Tessa Korr.
Use Glider Jax's routes to avoid the guards.
Secure the crates at the Grip-Plate Corridors with Cling.

quests.title: The Echoing Core
quests.narrative_guidance: Repairing a corrupted AI fragment to unlock Foundry blueprints.
improvisation_points: Receive the corrupted data-shard from The Fragment Voice.
Distribute the data-packets through Link's slum network.
Stabilize the final sequence at the Bedrock-Anchor with Bolt.

quests.title: Molten Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: A strike against the Molten Order to disrupt their control over the vents.
improvisation_points: Acquire incendiary charges from Miran Flux.
Sabotage the pivot-joint stabilizers with Grease-Monkey Kael.
Infiltrate the final crevice with Squeeze to plant the core charge.

quests.title: The Relic Crucible
quests.narrative_guidance: A lost relic of the Molten Order has been detected near a cooling flange. It must be recovered and stabilized.
improvisation_points: Speak with Vrax Cinderskull to get the location of the rival scavenger den.
Take the recovered thermal casing to Pyre-Tech Kael for heat-shielding.
Deliver the relic to Jurik Vale to analyze the slag residue.

quests.title: Echoes of the Deep
quests.narrative_guidance: The Fragment Voice is picking up signals from the deep crypts that match ancient AI signatures.
improvisation_points: Translate the Fragment Voice's garbled coordinates.
Take the sensor data to Miri to filter out tectonic noise.
Deliver the decrypted key to Zee to unlock the ancient beacon.

quests.title: The Sulphur Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Miran Flux wants to cause a massive distraction by rupturing a sulphur main to bypass security.
improvisation_points: Acquire the explosive charges from Miran Flux.
Coordinate with Nox to find the weakest point in the sulphur pipes.
Turn the 'evidence' over to Enforcer Krell to frame a rival gang.

quests.title: Foundry Blueprint Heist
quests.narrative_guidance: A rare alloy blueprint is floating in the Zero-G Foundry, and Trader Wick wants it before the Governors do.
improvisation_points: Receive the manifest from Trader Wick.
Help Tali calibrate the magnets to catch the drifting data core.
Smuggle the core to Grik in the Graveyard for safe storage.

quests.title: Seismic Instability
quests.narrative_guidance: Elara predicts a quake that could destroy the Magma Wells. Defensive measures must be reinforced.
improvisation_points: Get the seismic predictions from Elara.
Help Boren reinforce the tap-well supports.
Report the successful stabilization to Forge-Guard Orn.

quests.title: The Obsidian Ledger
quests.narrative_guidance: The Scribe has found a reference to a lost shipment of credits buried in the crypts.
improvisation_points: Consult the Scribe for the vault's ancient serial numbers.
Pay Silas to guide you through the trapped corridors of the crypts.
Deliver the ledger to Dock-Master Harl to clear the 'lost' cargo records.

quests.title: Solar Array Surge
quests.narrative_guidance: The radiant vents are overheating because the solar deflectors are misaligned.
improvisation_points: Meet Jace to identify the venting blockage points.
Work with Sol to re-align the mirrors on the Solar-Deflector Fin.
Clear the mercenary squatters from the array with help from Jax.
